tools.name: sanity_check_catalogue
tools.description: List the architecture checks the Sanity Check runs (families, plain-language descriptions), what is NOT assessed, pricing, and how run credits work. Free.

tools.name: sanity_check_sample
tools.description: Run the published sample intake (a fictional fintech with deliberately weak answers) live through the same checker and return its verdict + top findings. Free preview — this is the sample, not your architecture.

tools.name: sanity_check_credit_status
tools.description: Check payment state without spending anything: pass 'credit' (a web run-credit id from Stripe checkout) to see its status, or 'api_key' to see its run-credit balance. Free.

tools.name: sanity_check_run
tools.description: Run the full Technical Architecture Sanity Check on YOUR intake and return the verdict summary + report links (PDF/DOCX/HTML/Markdown/JSON). Costs ONE run credit: pass 'credit' (a web run-credit id) or 'api_key' (a key with balance). The intake is the SanityCheckIntakeV1 object (sections a-g; schema
